text: dsh-superlocalmemory 是面向 DSH Web 的插件包，通过官方 MCP 客户端把 SuperLocalMemory 的记忆工具接入 DSH。它在配置中注册一个 stdio MCP 服务，并启动本机的 slm mcp 命令，让服务发现的工具以 mcp__slm__ 前缀出现在会话中。适合希望让 DSH 会话使用 SuperLocalMemory 记忆能力的用户。使用前需安装 SuperLocalMemory，并确保 slm 可执行文件位于 DSH 进程可访问的 PATH 中；本插件本身只提供连接配置，不包含记忆逻辑。

dsh-superlocalmemory connects SuperLocalMemory to DSH through an MCP client. Its bundle starts the local `slm mcp` server over stdio and exposes discovered tools in DSH sessions. Install SuperLocalMemory and make `slm` available on DSH's PATH; this bundle provides connection setup only.
想让 DSH 会话能调用本地记忆工具。
如何通过 MCP 把 SuperLocalMemory 接到 DSH？
I want my DSH agent to remember facts across separate sessions using a local memory server.
dsh-superlocalmemory 的功能「接入记忆工具」：配置 MCP 客户端通过 stdio 启动 `slm mcp`，并将服务发现的工具暴露给 DSH 会话。

dsh-superlocalmemory README · dsh-superlocalmemory：A thin [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) bundle that connects [SuperLocalMemory](https://github.com/qualixar/superlocalmemory) to the harness over stdio MCP.

dsh-superlocalmemory README · dsh-superlocalmemory：SuperLocalMemory is a local-first memory layer for AI agents: one memory that any harness speaking MCP can share. This bundle contains no memory logic. It is one configuration row for DeepSeek Harness's official MCP client plugin (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`) that launches `slm mcp`, so SuperLocalMemory's tools show up in the harness as `mcp__slm__<tool>`.

dsh-superlocalmemory README · Prerequisites：1. DeepSeek Harness (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, see the [harness README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness#run)).
2. SuperLocalMemory installed so that `slm` is on your `PATH`:

```sh
   npm install -g superlocalmemory
   # or: pipx install superlocalmemory
   slm --version
   ```

dsh-superlocalmemory README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-superlocalmemory
```

Until the package is on npm, install from a clone instead:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/qualixar/dsh-superlocalmemory.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-superlocalmemory
```

Restart `dsh web`. The bundle is appended to the profile's bundle list and its patch inserts one MCP client row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: memory-superlocalmemory
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:

dsh-superlocalmemory README · Install：If you prefer not to install a bundle, copy that row into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`, or pass the file once with `dsh web --patch ./cordis.patch.yml`.

dsh-superlocalmemory README · Verify：1. Open **Settings > Plugins > Plugin list**. A `mcp-client` entry with id `memory-superlocalmemory` should show as Mounted and Enabled.
2. Start a session. Initial discovery is asynchronous, so wait for the `mcp__slm__...` tools to appear.
3. In one session ask the agent to remember a unique fact, then in a new session ask it to recall that fact. The harness's own [memory guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/user/guide/mcp-memory.md) describes this write, fresh-session recall check.
dsh-superlocalmemory README · Verify：You can also confirm the server on its own: `slm mcp` should start and wait for MCP messages on stdin.
dsh-superlocalmemory README · Changing the command：If `slm` is not on the `PATH` that the harness sees, set `command` to the absolute path of the executable (`which slm`).
